reason: The plugin is primarily a user-facing interactive entertainment utility: a Chinese chess AI opponent integrated into DSH WebUI as a floating navigation panel, with board play, move records, and AI-facing tools for status/check messaging/new-game control. It also includes persistence for game state/configuration and exposes local host routes, with no explicit external service or automation workflow focus.

summaries.zh: 这是一个在 DSH WebUI 中运行的中国象棋人机对战插件，提供可拖拽棋盘面板、实时落子记录和 AI 对局控制入口，并支持悔棋与存档。
summaries.en: This is a Chinese chess human-vs-AI plugin for DSH WebUI, offering a draggable board panel, live move history, AI game control tools, and support for undo and save/load flow.

capabilities: Provides an in-UI Chinese chess human-vs-AI game with playable board interactions and move history display.
Registers DSH-accessible game tools for messaging, querying game state, and starting a new game.
Persists game saves and configuration in browser/local runtime storage mechanisms.
